questions.question: Are you a citizen of India?

eligible.message: You are eligible to vote. Please ensure your name is registered in the voter list.

not_eligible.message: You are not eligible to vote yet. You must be 18+ and a citizen of India.

steps: Stay calm and inform the polling officer immediately.
Request to file a complaint at the polling station.
Provide your voter details for verification.
Check your voter slip or election ID card.
Visit the official voter portal or app.
Use your pincode to search for your polling booth.
